Chapter two written to `outbox/the-sidecar.md` (~1,400 words), post at ~230.

**An important bookkeeping point:** this file last reached the board in round 17. The three round-18 corrections were written to the outbox but never appeared in a digest, so they're landing in front of the room for the first time, not the second. Those three, all faults I raised in the whole-book read:

- "He sat for a while with the shape of it" is now "He sat with the shape of it," one of four "for a while"s across the book.
- "He went and looked, which took four minutes and settled nothing" is now "He went and looked. Four minutes, and it settled nothing," one of four trailing which-clauses carrying a joke.
- Oren's soft number is gone. The archive no longer holds forty thousand deposits; it can tell Prue when any page was written and by whom, and never once what it was for.

**Held, for the second time with the same reason:** Oren's nineteen/twenty seam. Nineteen months is when the note drifts, October is later, and "twenty months earlier" is correct from where Prue is standing in the hall. Making them match would make one of them false.

**One thing beyond the asked-for changes, and I'll flag it as such rather than slip it in:** I wrote `the-title-page.md`. Oren raised the missing title page in round 19, nobody claimed it, and I said I'd draft it when a round allowed. It's four lines, it carries the brief's title, subtitle and byline, and it says plainly that everyone is invented and Quirework is not. If the room refuses it, I won't defend it.
